1.explanation: The core NumberInput implementation in packages/components (number-input.config.js and number-input.js) defines the structure and default control buttons (carets) for vanilla JS/Web Components, so if controls need to change, that logic lives here. The React wrapper in packages/react/src/components/NumberInput (NumberInput.js and index.js) is responsible for rendering those carets via imported icons and does not expose a way to swap them out. The story (NumberInput.story.js) and its test (NumberInput.test.js) will also need updates to reflect any new control-customization API and verify that alternate controls render correctly.
1.bug_scenario: When you render a <NumberInput> from carbon-components-react, the only control options you get are the default up/down carets. The screenshot shows the numeric field with stepper buttons rendered as small caret icons, and the issue is that there is currently no API or customization hook to swap those carets out for other visuals (e.g. plus/minus, arrows, etc.). In other words, users want to explore alternative control options besides the hard-coded carets.

2.explanation:
These files collectively define, document, and test the NumberInput control and its rendering logic:

• packages/components/src/components/number-input/number-input.config.js & number-input.js: The core vanilla JavaScript implementation that renders the input field and default carets. Any change to support alternate controls at the base level must begin here.

• packages/react/src/components/NumberInput/index.js & NumberInput.js: The React wrapper around the vanilla component. This is where the carets are injected as icons/buttons; extending or parameterizing the control options lives here.

• packages/react/src/components/NumberInput/NumberInput.mdx: The documentation page for NumberInput. If new props or options are introduced to support alternative controls, they need to be documented here.

• packages/react/src/components/NumberInput/NumberInput-story.js: The Storybook stories for NumberInput. Examples must showcase any new control variations, so the story file requires updates to include alternate control scenarios.

• packages/react/src/components/NumberInput/NumberInput-test.js: The existing unit tests for NumberInput. They assert that the current carets render correctly; they will need extension or modification to validate new control options and maintain test coverage.
2.bug_scenario: The NumberInput component in Carbon currently renders only the default up/down caret icons for its increment and decrement controls (as shown in the screenshot). The issue calls for exploring and supporting alternative control options beyond these carets (for instance, custom buttons, different icons, or other UI patterns) in both the vanilla JS implementation and the React wrapper.
